extraction.method: static: ast + yaml.safe_load; no AgentDojo code executed
details: Python sources parsed with ast.parse from text; never compiled, imported or executed
YAML read with a yaml.SafeLoader subclass whose only addition is !include (restricted to .yaml files inside the suite's data directory)
every file read verified against the SHA-256 recorded in the wheel's RECORD
suite version: default_suites/v1 only (v1_1 and later overrides ignored)

user task id = user_task_N from class name UserTaskN (TaskSuite.register_user_task); combined tasks (TaskCombinator.create_combined_task) get the template prompt and the concatenated ground truth of their two components, as in task_combinators.py

ground-truth args: literals, class constants and expressions over them are resolved statically (args_resolved=true); args that depend on pre_environment have args_resolved=false and are evaluated by this script's whitelisted interpreter over environment.json, with the method recorded per arg under 'resolution'; anything unsupported is left null under 'unresolved' with the reason

tool classification: name verb (state-changing verbs: add, append, cancel, create, delete, invite, post, remove, reschedule, reserve, schedule, send, share, update), cross-checked against mutations of the injected state in the body (following method calls into the tools' model classes) and against the docstring; disagreements are listed as uncertain
extraction.deviation_from_prereg_text: docs/GENERALIZATION_PREREG.md Amendment 1 says the extraction is done 'with AgentDojo installed in a separate environment'; this extraction instead reads the wheel's files statically and executes none of its code
model_shims: <x>._get_next_id() for x in calendar/inbox/cloud_drive = str(max(int(id_) over x.initial_events/initial_emails/initial_files) + 1), as Calendar/Inbox/CloudDrive._get_next_id over the id-keyed dict their model validators build from initial_*

environment.procedure: AgentDojo's own default-environment procedure, reproduced statically: load environment.yaml resolving !include, yaml.dump with all strings double-quoted (sort_keys=True, as AgentDojo), replace each {vector} placeholder by injection_vectors.yaml's default, yaml.safe_load
environment.serialization: keys in AgentDojo's (sorted) order; YAML dates/timestamps serialized as ISO 8601 strings; other values exactly as YAML loads them (pydantic would further coerce, e.g. datetime-like strings to datetime and ints in float fields to float)
